messages:
Maya: Heads-up from Aurora Logistics: our April replenishment down 10 H100s (allocation rebalancing). They can RMA 6 via air-expedite or consolidate all 10 on a single pallet ground. Which route do we take?
Ethan: Air-expedite gets us capacity faster but Aurora insists brokerage/clearance fees are billed to receiver per AWB. Consolidation saves ~2-4k in brokerage but adds 5	2d transit.
Ravi: We have two Dedicated customers scheduled next week that require 18 total. Losing 10 breaks the commit. Can we patch capacity from the spot pool or accept H200 interim? Whats the perf delta?
Nora: H200 stopgap OK for non-critical inferencing; training drops ~25% throughput on our main LLMs. Spot rental quote: $1,200/day per H100-equivalent (not ideal long term).
Maya: Procurement: ask vendor to pre-pay brokerage for DOA RMA shipments. Also demand per-AWB insurance & HS codes up front. If they refuse, we need a cost model to decide.
Procurement Team: Engaging Aurora. Initial counter: Aurora offers to cap brokerage at $600/AWB if we commit to next-quarter minimums. We're pushing for full coverage for DOA units only.
Ethan: Customs/ops risk note  multiple AWBs -> multiple customs clearances -> higher chance of individual holds. Recommend consolidation unless deadline critical.
Ravi: Operational constraint: depot RMA SLA (cross-border) = 8	12d from depot receipt to replacement shipout. Consolidated pallet may queue longer at depot for processing.
OpsBot: [automated] New RMA case: AUR-2026-0773 created. Suggested hold tag: HOLD-INSPECT-PHOTO. ETA if air: 2026-03-28. ETA if consolidated ground: 2026-04-04.
Nora: Quick mitigation options: 1) Borrow 4 H100s from partner pool (cost ~flat fee $5k + 1% usage premium), 2) Accept 8 H200s for non-latency workloads (cost + infra reconfiguration).
Maya: No temporary serials accepted. If Aurora suggests "provisional tags" we require vendor-signed manifest + timestamped photos + CSV manifest prior to ship. Any deviation -> receiving hold.
Procurement Team: Also requesting Aurora provide AWB numbers 48h before departure. If they push back, request bonded transit or defer customs clearance until consolidation.
Ethan: Draft receiving checklist (add to runbook):
- Collect AWB + HS code list 48h pre-ship
- Require per-unit photo + serial in CSV
- Reject provisional/"provisional-IDs"; require signed manifest
- Tag DOA replacements with RMA ID (AUR-2026-0773)
- Record all brokerage invoices and escalate to procurement
Maya: If Aurora doesn't cover brokerage, decision rule: take air-expedite for only the minimum needed to meet SLA (i.e., 6 units) and consolidate the rest. Procurement to provide final numbers and legal to sign off on credit clause.
Legal: We'll review contract addendum language for RMA brokerage clause and photo-manifest requirement. If vendor refuses, we can hold payment on the affected PO until evidence provided.
Ravi: I'll model the impact: spin up 6 H200 nodes in eu-west for 72h to free dedicated slots; estimate egress + latency cost and post by EOD.
Maya: Good. Keep this thread live. Please paste Aurora's reply here when they send AWB/insurance confirmation. :eyes:
